description: One static 16x16 pixel-art UI Ready icon visibly using a check mark with asymmetrical arms to convey successful completion. Transparent background. Readable silhouette at 1x and 3x nearest-neighbor scale on #172336. Use the existing cool blue UI accent direction (#70b9ed is a cue, not exact palette membership); other colours may dominate. No fixed palette or binary-alpha requirement. Expert proposal: deliberate clusters and contours for recognition at this size, allowing intentional isolated detail, authored antialiasing, partial alpha, shading and backing motifs. Ready is a proposed representative sample, not an approved family style.
